traps.why: PBr₃ gives the bromide. For the chloride use SOCl₂ (or HCl/ZnCl₂).
PCC oxidises; you need a substitution of OH by Cl.
There is a reaction: SOCl₂, pyr does change butan-1-ol.

explanation: SOCl₂ converts the OH into a chlorosulfite leaving group; chloride then displaces it: R–Cl.
